tool.name: OGS: constructMeshesFromGeometry
tool.description: Converts a geometry defined on a given mesh to distinct meshes.

param.label: searchlength
param.help: search length determining radius for the node search algorithm. Non-negative floating point number

param.label: geometry
param.help: Input (.gml | .gli). The file name of the input geometry (the wrapper accepts .gml only)

param.label: mesh
param.help: Input (.vtu). The file name of the input mesh where the geometry is defined

param.label: multiple nodes allowed
param.help: Allows multiple mesh nodes in eps environment.

tool.help: Converts a geometry defined on a given mesh to distinct meshes. The documentation is available at https://www.opengeosys.org/docs/tools/meshing-submeshes/constructmeshesfromgeometry/.
